    c = Counter(votes)

def agg_weighted(votes, weights):
    scores = {}

    if votes[0] == votes[1] == votes[2]:

    for v, p in zip(votes, reliabilities):

        lp, l1p = np.log(p), np.log(1.0 - p)

    "bayesian": agg_bayesian,
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def compute_asr(clean_decs, atk_decs, clean_gt, atk_gt):
    cc = fl = 0
